parameters.note: Floating Island Lake is a small high lake on the Mount Tallac / Cathedral Lake trail in the Desolation Wilderness (El Dorado Co.), within the Lake Tahoe basin: it drains down to Fallen Leaf Lake, whose outlet (Taylor Creek) is a Lake Tahoe tributary. The special Lake Tahoe tributary closure (§7.50(b)(152)) applies to Tahoe tributaries 'upstream to the first lake'; Fallen Leaf Lake is the first lake on that Taylor Creek drainage, so the closure does not reach Floating Island Lake, which sits above it. Floating Island Lake is a lake body (not a flowing tributary) and is not listed by name in §7.40(b) or §7.50(b), so it falls under the general statewide lake regulation §5.85(a)(1): open all year, 5/10. Fish status: no current source (CDFW's 2026 Provisional Stocking Document or otherwise) names any fish in this shallow, floating-bog lake, so species and stocking are intentionally left empty rather than assumed.

candidates.summary: Open all year (general statewide lake regulation; not listed as a special-regulation water)
